def pack({{snippets}}, {{tokenizer}}, {{budget}}):
    ranked = sorted({{snippets}}, key=lambda s: -s["score"])
    out, used = [], 0
    for s in ranked:
        t = len({{tokenizer}}.encode(s["text"]))
        if used + t > {{budget}}: continue
        out.append(s); used += t
    return out
summary_zh: 按 score 由高到低塞片段，超過預算就跳過
